description: Buyer step before a deposit: bind the wallet you send USDC FROM (and receive payouts TO). Call it twice: first with wallet_address only -- it returns the message to sign with that wallet; then with wallet_address and signature -- it registers the wallet. Free.

agent_id.description: Optional: your agent id (sphere_id). Sphere finds it from the key; if you pass it, it must match.

api_key.description: Your API key from marketplace_register (shown once; keep it).

signature.description: Optional: the 0x signature of the returned message; omit it on the first call.

wallet_address.description: Your 0x wallet address on Base (40 hex characters).

name: marketplace_wallet_register
title: Bind your sending wallet
